summary: Frontend-only validation completed for /privacy and /scheduled handoff UIs on mobile viewport. Both routes loaded without red screen/crash, privacy picker was interactive, scheduled compose modal opened from FAB, and safe Convex fallback prevented route crashes during backend Server Error responses.

integration_issues.issue: Convex privacy:getSettings repeatedly returns Server Error; route remains usable due safe fallback. privacy:updateSettings mutation also returns Server Error after picker selection, so persistence could not be validated in this run.
Convex scheduledMessages:listMine returns Server Error in console, but scheduled screen still renders and compose modal can open due safe fallback.

action_items: Investigate Convex Server Error for privacy:getSettings and scheduledMessages:listMine to restore real data hydration.
Investigate Convex Server Error for privacy:updateSettings so picker changes persist successfully.
Consider user-facing non-blocking error feedback when privacy update mutation fails (current behavior silently reverts).
critical_code_review_comments: useSafeConvexQuery stores fallback in a ref only on initial render; if fallback prop changes later, stale fallback may be used. Add a sync effect for fallbackRef.current.
Target routes include stable testIDs for key interactions (privacy picker and scheduled compose), enabling reliable mobile automation coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified requested UI stability and interactions specifically under Convex failure conditions. No red screen seen. Main remaining work is backend/integration recovery and re-test of data persistence paths after fixes.
rca_of_issue: RCA: Convex queries/mutations for privacy and scheduled are returning Server Error from backend layer. The new useSafeConvexQuery mitigates crash risk by catching query failures and returning defaults, so route rendering and UI interactions still work. Repro: open /privacy or /scheduled on preview URL and observe console warnings; choose privacy option and observe privacy:updateSettings Server Error. Mitigation: fix Convex endpoint failures and retest persistence while keeping safe query guard for resilience.
